name: derate-chart-pack-extension
description: omp extension for the derate chart pack: chart_recommend/chart_lookup/dataset_lookup/schema_validate tools, /chart /chart-for /chart-new /chart-data /chart-sample /chart-check /chart-gallery, and the hooks that check edited charts, rebuild registry.json and gallery.html, log CHANGELOG.md and gate the session on the scoped check. Everything runs .omp/charts/scripts/cli.mjs.
